title: Jammy Solo Mediterranean Custard Pudding
description: A pillowy, solo dinner Mediterranean dish featuring custard powder, steam, and a Buddhist-temple-friendly approach. Perfect for a relaxing evening meal.

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: whole milk or a non-dairy alternative

instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the water, milk, custard powder, sugar, lemon zest, and salt. Heat over medium heat, whisking constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract and honey. Let it cool slightly.
Place a piece of phyllo dough in a ramekin, cutting it to fit the bottom and sides.
Brush the phyllo with a little water and place a second piece on top, brushing with more water. Repeat this process until all the phyllo is used, ending with a layer of phyllo on top.
Pour the cooled custard mixture into the phyllo-lined ramekin, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Dot the top of the custard with almond butter.
Bake the pudding for 20-25 minutes, or until the phyllo is golden brown and the custard is set.
Remove the pudding from the oven and sprinkle with dried thyme. Let it cool slightly.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves and serve warm.
Serve with a side of fruit or a mixed green salad for a light and satisfying dinner.
For a vegan version, replace the honey with maple syrup or another sweetener of your choice.
